workflow.name: QA Document Workflow
workflow.prompt: QA only: draft two short stages using built-in document tools. First save a Markdown report, then require my decision before saving an HTML summary. No external apps, shell, network tools, source changes, messages, publication, deployment or provisioning.

stages.title: Save Markdown Report
stages.instructions: Use built-in document tools to save the analysis as a Markdown report. No external apps, shell, network tools, source changes, messages, publication, deployment, or provisioning.

stages.title: HTML Summary Decision
stages.instructions: Review the Markdown report and decide whether to save an HTML summary using built-in tools. No external apps, shell, network tools, source changes, messages, publication, deployment, or provisioning.
